blocks.html: Robinsons Malls spreads the Spirit of Giving in Malabon with The Gift of Change Libreng Bakuna
For many, Christmas is the time of giving- a time to remember our less fortunate brothers and sisters and experience the joy and fulfillment of sharing what you have to those in great need.

Perhaps, one of the best gifts one can give and receive this Christmas is the gift of good health. Realizing this, Robinsons Malls The Gift of Change chose to conduct its leg of Libreng Bakuna in Robinsons Town Mall Malabon servicing three nearby barangays namely, Brgy. Tinajeros, Brgy. Acacia and Brgy. Potrero. This CSR activity gave the residents more reasons to go to Robinsons Town Mall Malabon making their visits an essential part of their daily routine. "Robinsons Town Mall Malabon is growing with the community it serves. The activities that we hold here, like this Libreng Bakuna, are borne out of our interactions with our patrons," Regional Operations Manager for Robinsons Town Mall Malabon Darwin Renolayan proudly shares.

One hundred fifty indigents from these three barangays were able to receive free flu vaccination – an important protection from the Influenza virus. "Flu is a common communicable disease that may cost an arm and a leg for a financially-challenged Malabonian family if not treated early &amp; properly. The free vaccine we gave today easily translates to current and future savings for those we were able to serve," Darwin Renolayan added. Through Robinsons Malls The Gift of Change Libreng Bakuna, the beneficiaries are given the comfort and security of having a healthier year ahead of them.

The Gift of Change is an ongoing coinbank donation campaign in all Robinsons Malls nationwide. It is currently supporting twenty-three (23) communities, with CSR projects to include The Gift of Sight, Pailaw sa Barangay, Binyagang Bayan, Libreng Bakuna, Kasalang Bayanand Libreng Pintura para Sa Eskuwela.
